programme.desc: Park Ranger Rose's favorite tree might be off limits for climbing unless Rubble and Grandpa can come up with a solution. / The Crew build a feeder for Farmer Zoe's chickens, but when they get loose, it's up to the pups to safely rescue them.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S10 Ep.1001: Pups Save the Wacky Water Skiers / Pups Save the Mayor's Assistant
programme.desc: When Emmy and Eddie take a joyride, Hurricane Harrigan and Cap'n Turbot get caught water skiing behind the out of- control boat. // Daring Danny X becomes Mayor Humdinger's assistant, and builds a theme park! A jealous Humdinger sabotages the rides.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S10 Ep.1002: Pups Save a High-Flying Hen / Pups Save a Sloth
programme.desc: After Chickaletta accidentally takes flight on a toy airplane, it's up to the Paw Patrol to rescue her. // Mayor Humdinger mistakes a sloth for a monkey. He races the Paw Patrol to find it when it goes missing to cover up his blunder.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.123: Barba TV / The Museum
programme.desc: The barbababies are glued to the TV. Since they love it so much, their parents encourage them to make their own shows. // The Barbapapa visit the museum of evolution. On the program: creation of the Earth, Precambrian submarine and... dinosaurs!

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.124: Barbazoo Can't Say ''No'' / The Doppelganger
programme.desc: Barbazoo is ready to help. But Barbabright and Barbabelle abuse his kindness and drive him crazy. // By chance, Barbazoo realizes he can imitate Barbapapa. He uses this opportunity to distribute chores to his brothers and sisters. Will they find out?

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.104: The Magic Spyglass / The Stone of Life
programme.desc: Santi and crew are after the legendary Magic Spyglass! But things get tricky when Enrique Real de Palacios III joins the chase. / Santi and crew follow a map to a special treasure, but Bonnie and Sir Butterscotch are hot on their trail.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.105: Princess and the Pirate Puppy / Caracol Cove
programme.desc: Santi and crew will have to team up with a pirate puppy to stop Bonnie Bones and save an old friend. // Enrique's new gold-digging machine threatens Lorelai's home.

programme.title: Deer Squad S2 Ep.205: The Wig of Power / The Duck who Parped Wolf
programme.desc: Steel Tower is under new management not once but twice - can the Deer Squad return it to a distraught Sir Steel? // Steel and Lady Fluffpot are putting up a play. Ian's false alarms frustrate Kai, but one of them turns out to be a REAL emergency!

programme.title: The Creature Cases S2 Ep.202: The Case of the Stinky Swamp / The Case of the Talking Tree
programme.desc: When a stinky smell permeates a swamp, Sam and Kit arrive to track down the stinkers. // When some critters are scared away from their home by a loud, haunting voice, Sam and Kit are called.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.250: Daddy Pig's Birthday
programme.desc: Today is Daddy Pig's birthday, but he has to go to work. While he is away, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George prepare a special birthday surprise.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.251: Sleepover
programme.desc: Peppa is going for a sleepover at Zoë Zebra’s house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant. The girls stay up playing games and having fun. At last they feel sleepy. They all snuggle up in their sleeping bags and fall asleep.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.252: Stars
programme.desc: It is night time and the sky is full of stars. Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on and they go outside to look at the stars. The stars look very tiny, but when Peppa and George look through a telescope the stars look bigger.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S3 Ep.301: Work and Play
programme.desc: When Peppa and Suzy learn that grown ups must work all day, they decide to play at working in a store. But they quickly get tired of it.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S3 Ep.302: The Rainbow
programme.desc: Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S3 Ep.303: Pedro's Cough
programme.desc: Pedro gets a contagious cough at daycare and other children soon catch it. When it's time to go the grown-ups catch it too, including Madame Gazelle. Doctor Brown Bear gives them terrible-tasting medicine, but who will look after him when he is sick?

programme.title: Peppa Pig S3 Ep.304: The Library
programme.desc: Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S3 Ep.305: The Camper Van
programme.desc: Peppa and her family go on vacation in a special van. Peppa is surprised to find that at a push of a button the van converts into a mini-house for them to sleep in!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S3 Ep.306: The Camping Holiday
programme.desc: Peppa and her family are on holiday in their trailer van. They decide to go to Duck Land, a special park where they can see the ducks in the river, and are surprised when they learn that their van can convert into a boat!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S3 Ep.307: Compost
programme.desc: Peppa and George take a bin of vegetable peelings to Grandpa Pig's compost heap. Worms inside the bin turn the peelings into compost, which Granny and Grandpa use to help their plants grow.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S3 Ep.308: Richard Rabbit Comes to Play
programme.desc: Richard Rabbit comes to play with George, and Suzy Sheep comes to play with Peppa! The boys and girls don't want to play the same games, but they all like jumping up and down in muddy puddles.

programme.title: DORA S3 Ep.307: Learning To Fly / Queen Swiper
programme.desc: Dora and Boots help Dulce the Dragon learn to fly so she can reach her parents at Cloudy Caves. // After La Reina and Swiper's bodies were switched by Big Red Chicken's magic, Dora and Boots help them switch back!

programme.title: DORA S1 Ep.121: Wonky Wishing Wand
programme.desc: Big Red Chicken's magic goes wonky and not only shrinks himself, but causes wacky things to happen throughout the rainforest. Dora has to fix it!

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.105: Tiny Croc / Camping Croc
programme.desc: Daisy and Mr. Crocodile find a tiny lizard who wants to be just like Mr. Crocodile. // Winston tries to be the leader on a nature hike, but his high-tech gadget gets everyone lost in the woods.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.205: Ah! My Beautiful Castle / The Sand Is Running Away
programme.desc: During a bike ride, the Barbapapa family discovers an old medieval castle in ruins. // Barbapapa and Lolita were traveling in a balloon, but caught in a storm they ended up stranded on a deserted island.

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.102: Bada-Bam
programme.desc: Barbabright captured a melody from Mars. The Barbapapas build a rocket to go to the red planet.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S5 Ep.501: The Crew Builds A Stadium Dome / The Crew Builds A Baggage Claim
programme.desc: When Speed Meister rains on the Builder Cove Sing-Off, Rubble & Crew saves the show by building a giant dome over the stadium! // Rubble & Crew build an elaborate baggage claim system at the airport when nobody can find their bags after flying home.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.218: The Crew Builds A Giant Skateboard
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew build a supersized skateboard for Auntie Crane and River's show. But when it rolls out of control, the pups lead the chase!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S13 Ep.1301: Pups Solve a Snap-N-Wrap Problem / Pups Save Helga and the Dingers
programme.desc: Before Chickaletta's playdate with Baby Yukiko, Mayor Goodway baby-proofs the playground, wrapping everything in rubbery Snap-N-Wrap. // Mayor Humdinger loses his voice on the day of the Annual Adventure Bay Sing-Off

programme.title: PAW Patrol S3 Ep.302: Pups Save a Goldrush
programme.desc: When a grizzled old prospector discovers gold in Adventure Bay, it’s a bona fide, dog gone, gold rush!
